newsitem.title: USA: White House critical of Republican tax bills.
newsitem.headline: White House critical of Republican tax bills.

text.p: The White House reiterated on Friday that the House-passed tax cut bill and a companion measure headed toward passage in the Senate were unacceptable to President Clinton in their present form.
"The President wants a tax cut. He wants a targeted tax cut, and the House and Senate measures don't quite muster up at this point," White House spokesman Mike McCurry said.

McCurry said Clinton would specify what he will and will not accept on Monday in advance of congressional negotiations on a final bill. "We think we've got a considerable influence yet to be brought to the table," he said.
